integration_reference: V44 frozen C2/RGBA/SurfaceLOD; old M2 is provenance only

input_scope.other_camera_RGB: excluded and unaudited, never represented as all-five-camera blinding
input_scope.LiDAR: All five original sensors/two returns; rebuild from raw before point filtering. No old pooled/interpolated geometry is estimator input.
input_scope.sensor_model: Original FRONT Brown-Conrady intrinsics and actual pose. Conservative finite-prism interval projection plus pixel padding; rolling-shutter motion bound is recorded but not an independently validated physical calibration.
input_scope.claim_limit: FRONT-only conditional benchmark under declared sensor bounds, not proof of all-sensor never-visible road. Full physical strictness remains uncertified until timing/distortion and an external input-isolation audit pass.

appearance_blind.RGB: Mask target+guard in every declared raw JPEG before resize, statistics, feature extraction or candidate generation.
appearance_blind.geometry: Original XYZ-only LiDAR may remain in target; no intensity, elongation, point RGB, target markings or target-fitted appearance.
appearance_blind.claim: Appearance completion with measured geometry, not joint completion.

geometry_RGB_blind.RGB: Same masked RGB and validity as appearance_blind.
geometry_RGB_blind.geometry: Remove every raw return within the context-height-interval target+guard prism before any fusion, nearest-pixel selection, ground labeling, plane fit or encoder.
geometry_RGB_blind.claim: Joint geometry/material completion from legal context; must not load original surface or scene checkpoints.

selection.unit: One persistent finite anchor-local XY patch with explicit coordinate_anchor to world metres; all views share its identity.
selection.candidate_rule: Regular geometry grid; measured support and >=3 direct real-return FRONT witnesses recomputed from XYZ/cameras/annotation guards without RGB/quality gates; spatial SHA256 ranking. Never load old source_valid (it includes full-image sharpness), source_rgb, color stability, reconstruction loss or completion output for selection.
selection.overlap_rule: Target+guard rectangles cannot overlap between any selected patches; near-overlapping alternatives are excluded rather than split across arms.
selection.material_strata: Marking/asphalt labels are evaluator-only and currently unannotated. No claim that all marking classes have reference.
selection.slope_reference: Measured target heights may support a sealed local slope diagnostic; fitted normals/slopes are reference proxies, not independent ground-truth normals.

masking.height_prism: Context-only z range outside ALL selected target+guard rectangles, within 8m of each center, expanded by 0.75m. No exact target height or slope enters mask shape.
masking.missing_pixel_semantics: Explicit valid=false; neutral fill is not negative evidence, ground truth or a road observation.
masking.derived_data: Create from blinded sources only; same patch/guard/source/mask hashes are cache keys. Global encoders operate after masking.
masking.finite_support: Any new Gaussian, surfel, interpolation kernel or filter whose effective support crosses target+guard is tainted unless rebuilt from legal context. Bound/radius must be declared.

forbidden_estimator_dependencies: full199 initialization or fitted target geometry in geometry_RGB_blind
V44 complete scene or old render outputs
sealed evaluator references or target marking labels

sealed_evaluation.store: evaluator_only/ outside public/inputs/; estimator must be launched with only explicit public inputs mounted or copied to an isolated work directory
sealed_evaluation.isolation_limit: Directory separation and allowlist auditing are implemented; this is not an OS-level secrecy guarantee. An estimator run must separately audit its process/filesystem inputs.
sealed_evaluation.evaluator: Separate evaluator invocation after candidate/seed/settings/artifact hashes are frozen; sealed-test RGB, height, markings and errors cannot choose candidates, splits or settings.
sealed_evaluation.references: Real measured geometry and qualified FRONT radiance witnesses; stable radiance is a proxy, not independently measured unshadowed albedo.
metrics: per-patch macro and pixel-weighted linear-RGB MAE/sRGB PSNR
marking centerline/width/connectivity only when sealed labels exist

R0_protection.domain_source: Original V44 observations, original a6_probe_reference, fixed raw137 ROI; never current or candidate predictions.
R0_protection.a6: Original visible[0] RGB and depth_valid[0] measured depth; component alpha*T and tails, same identity in both states.
R0_protection.a37: Original visible[1] RGB and depth_valid[1] where present in keep; deleted contribution exactly zero in delete.
R0_protection.road_keep: Original obs.road uses original real RGB.
R0_protection.road_delete_proxy: obs.road_edit AND original ground_beneath_a37_proxy depth>0; proxy target is labeled explicitly and never hidden GT.
R0_protection.protected: obs.protect minus original a6/a37 visible masks; retain outside/seam tails separately.
R0_protection.verified_new_road: Freeze measurement-only geometry and unoccluded verified support before R0 candidate render; do not derive acceptance domain from candidate alpha.
R0_protection.preservation_gates: Report signed changes, weighted mean and p90/p99/max; no road aggregate offsets foreground regression. Quality acceptance remains separate from engineering pass.

compute.long_run_smoke_required_if_later_authori: For an experiment of about one hour or more, about ten minutes in the real GPU environment with save/eval/full resume/next stage, separately accounted.
